html: I. נקד (√ of foll.; NH נָקַד point, furnish with points; cf. Syriac ܢܩܰܙ (very rare) PS2453; n. ܢܽܘܩܙܳܐ, but also ܢܽܘܩܕܳܐ point, mark; vbs. perhaps denom.; Arabic نَقَطَ point or dot (letter, word, etc.), ii. make specks, spots, on garment, etc., prob. loan-word Frä 195; Di Lex. 648 cp. Ethiopic ነቅዘ be decayed, worm-eaten (of wood, bread, etc.)).
